delivery_reference_contract.completion_rule: Evaluate all 53 requirements together with the actual delivery receipt; technical acceptance and bounded historical limitations do not establish unperformed cleanup, commit, push or final CI

predicates.publication: delivery-receipt.md records actual staged Git-blob scan, source/published hash mapping and resolved relative links
predicates.cleanup: delivery-receipt.md records actual absence of the exact owned raw-cache/script root and closure of only owned preview/browser processes
predicates.protection: delivery-receipt.md records final protected-data hashes/skip flags and the separately disclosed original-workspace drift
predicates.commit_push_clean: PR #1 postcommit receipt identifies the commit containing this receipt, matching remote branch HEAD, actual push and clean task worktree
predicates.final_ci: PR #1 postcommit receipt identifies successful final push and PR workflows, actual checkout commits/ordered PR parents, required gate coverage and unchanged fe product-source identity
